facts.text: Maharishi International University utilizes a Consciousness-Based Education model where all students practice Transcendental Meditation daily and take courses on a block system of 1 to 2 classes in 4- to 8-week intervals with no finals week.

sources.title: Maharishi International University | Accredited & Nonprofit
sources.quote: At MIU you never juggle 4-5 classes and homework at once. Students take just 1-2 classes in 4-8 week blocks. No finals week! Instead, you get a 3-day weekend at the end of each block.
